record.paper_title: Open problems for tractability of multivariate integration
record.original_question: For integration in the weighted Sobolev Hilbert space on [0,1]^d with kernel product_{j=1}^d (1 + gamma_j min(x_j,t_j)), positive nonincreasing weights gamma_j, and sum gamma_j finite, if s_gamma = inf {s>0 : sum gamma_j^s is finite}, is the strong-tractability exponent p* equal to max(1, 2 s_gamma)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider numerical integration over the unit cube $[0,1]^d$ in the weighted Sobolev reproducing-kernel Hilbert space $H(K_{d,\gamma})$ with kernel
$$K_{d,\gamma}(x,t) = \prod_{j=1}^{d}\bigl(1+\gamma_j\,\min(x_j,t_j)\bigr), \qquad x,t\in[0,1]^d,$$
where $\gamma = (\gamma_j)_{j\ge 1}$ is a fixed sequence of positive nonincreasing weights with $\sum_{j=1}^{\infty}\gamma_j<\infty$. For a quadrature rule $Q_{n,d}(f)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_i f(x^{(i)})$ using $n$ function evaluations, let
$$e(n,d) = \inf_{Q_{n,d}}\sup_{\|f\|_{H(K_{d,\gamma})}\le 1}\bigl|I_d(f)-Q_{n,d}(f)\bigr|,\qquad I_d(f)=\int_{[0,1]^d}f(x)\,dx,$$
and $e(0,d)=\sup_{\|f\|\le 1}|I_d(f)|$ be the initial error. The problem is called strongly tractable if there exist constants $C,p>0$ such that for every $d\ge 1$ and every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$,
$$\min\{n : e(n,d)\le \varepsilon\, e(0,d)\}\le C\,\varepsilon^{-p}.$$
The exponent of strong tractability $p^{*}=p^{*}(\gamma)$ is the infimum of all $p$ for which such a bound holds. Define
$$s_\gamma = \inf\Bigl\{s>0 : \sum_{j=1}^{\infty}\gamma_j^{\,s}<\infty\Bigr\}.$$
Is it true that
$$p^{*}(\gamma) = \max\bigl(1,\,2\,s_\gamma\bigr)\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: A literature search reveals related work by Sloan–Woźniakowski and by Hickernell–Woźniakowski establishing that the strong-tractability exponent lies between 1 and 2 under summability of the weights, and constructive QMC results achieving the upper bound. However, no source clearly confirms the exact identity $p^{*}=\max(1,2s_\gamma)$ for the Sobolev kernel $\prod(1+\gamma_j\min(x_j,t_j))$; the precise value of $p^*$ in this generality appears not to be settled.

status_evidence.title: On strong tractability of weighted multivariate integration
status_evidence.snippet: Sloan and Woźniakowski established a necessary and sufficient condition of strong tractability in weighted Sobolev spaces, and showed that the ε-exponent of strong tractability is between 1 and 2.
status_evidence.claim: Bounds 1 ≤ p* ≤ 2 are known but the exact value in terms of s_gamma is not stated as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Open problems for tractability of multivariate integration
status_evidence.claim: The identity is posed as an open problem.
